scope: alt text, read against the committed crop -- batch 2, grade 6 2024 (9 of 152 figures)
question: Is every fact the alt text states shown in the artwork, and does it identify the figure? Alt text is an identification, not a substitute for the picture: reaching the answer is the longDescription's job and is not asked of it here.

vocabulary.sound: every stated fact is drawn and the figure is identified
vocabulary.wrong: states something the artwork does not show
vocabulary.insufficient: true, but does not identify the figure or omits what distinguishes it from its neighbours

g6-2024-037#0.alt: Four labelled points A, B, C and D plotted on a coordinate plane ruled from negative 12 to 12.
g6-2024-037#0.whatTheArtworkShows: A four-quadrant coordinate plane ruled two units to the square. The x-axis is numbered -12 to 12 in twos (grid reaching one square further each way); the y-axis is numbered only -6 to 6 (grid reaching to 8 and -8). Four labelled points: A (-6, 6), D (4, 6), B (2, -4), C (12, -4).
g6-2024-037#0.replacement: Four labelled points A, B, C and D on a coordinate plane numbered in twos, negative 12 to 12 across and negative 6 to 6 up.
g6-2024-037#0.why: 'Ruled from negative 12 to 12' is true of the x-axis only: the y-axis is numbered -6 to 6 and the grid stops at 8, so the plane is a wide rectangle, not the square the alt describes. The points and their letters are right.
